note: Synthesized calibration cases for OVERLAP_REFUSE_THRESHOLD (#10550). The two evidence rows carry ONLY the cluster hash of the open draft PR and the patch target; every text field is invented for this fixture, no learning or PR content is copied.

evidence.description: This skill should be used when stale or orphaned Git worktrees pile up and need careful pruning, branch cleanup and removal checks during parallel development.
when_to_use: Several feature worktrees exist and some branches were already merged
A worktree directory remains after its branch was deleted

evidence.description: This skill should be used when the Pencil design tool MCP server is missing or unregistered and the desktop app or IDE extension must be detected and registered again.
when_to_use: Pencil MCP tools are unavailable in a session
The IDE extension is installed but the MCP server is not registered

negatives.description: This skill should be used when outbound network calls fail intermittently and need bounded retries with exponential delay and jitter.
when_to_use: A flaky upstream returns transient errors
A request storm follows a brief outage

negatives.description: This skill should be used when importing spreadsheet rows needs column type checks, duplicate detection and a rejected-row report.
when_to_use: A bulk upload contains malformed rows
Totals differ between the source sheet and the stored rows

negatives.description: This skill should be used when meeting times, recurring events and daylight saving transitions must stay correct across user locales.
when_to_use: An invite shows the wrong hour for a remote attendee
A recurring event shifts after a clock change

negatives.description: This skill should be used when published pages need accessible text alternatives reviewed for photos, charts and decorative graphics.
when_to_use: A page ships with unlabeled charts
Screen reader users report missing image descriptions
